about: Inputs and outputs of the Rust geometry kernel (label-anything-core: geom, grid, index) for the TypeScript port, which must reproduce every value bit for bit.
regenerate: cd rust && cargo run -p label-anything-core --example geom_oracle (--check: fail if this file is stale; also run by cargo test -p label-anything-core --test geom_oracle)
format: sections: {name: [{in, out}]}; floats are shortest round-trip JSON numbers, non-finite values the strings inf, -inf, nan; coverage and occupancy grids are base64 of the row-major u8 cells
